text:
dmitri: kicked off a cross-GPU attention kernel sweep (A100 / H100 / L40S) to root-cause the KV-cache stalls from last canary. ran flash/fused/paged variants across seq=[128,512,1024,2048] and batch=[1,4,8,16]. posting notes + raw highlights.

ci-bench-bot: finished job 542 — artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/542/{profiles,logs,flamegraphs}. cmd: `./bench_attn --gpus a100,h100,l40s --seq 128,512,1024,2048 --batch 1,4,8,16 --kernels flash,fused,paged --kv-cache on --prefetch on` :white_check_mark:

dmitri: TL;DR numbers (median p99 tokens/s, lower is worse):
- A100: flash best at seq<=512, fused slightly better at 1024, paged best at 2048 (paged wins for long seq when batch>=4).
- H100: unexpected: fused shows ~15% regression vs flash at seq=512 when batch>=8 (p99 up).
- L40S: paged performs consistently but lower throughput vs flash on short seq.

jenna: can you paste the small table for H100? that regression sounds bad. :eyes:

dmitri: H100 excerpt (p99 tokens/s):
```
seq  batch  flash   fused   paged
128   1     320k   310k    230k
512   4     260k   240k    200k
512   8     250k   212k    195k   <-- fused drops ~15% vs flash
1024  4     150k   145k    140k
2048  8      78k    74k     85k   <-- paged wins at 2048
```

ashley: hmm. that 512/8 fused drop smells like KV-cache spill or a kernel fallback path. any perf counters (L2, dram, r/w stalls)?

ops-bot: perf counters captured: SM%/L2_bw/DRAM_bw/inst_issued per GPU in artifacts. link: s3://redwood-bench/542/profiles/h100_counters.csv

dmitri: quick pointer from perf: for fused@512@8 on H100: SM util ~62% (should be >75%), L2 BW higher, DRAM BW spikes, and noticeable TLB misses around kernel boundary. stacktrace points to kvcache refill path hitting memcpy on CPU in a few shards.

matt: @dmitri could this be scheduling-induced fragmentation? we changed the per-request prefetch window in the batching heuristics last week (PR #1984). if fused relies on contiguous KV pages, a smaller prefetch could increase page faults.

dmitri: good call. I re-ran the H100 fused/512/8 with prefetch=2x (was 1x) — fused recovered ~12% throughput. artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/542/reruns/prefetch2x. So prefetch size interacts heavily with fused kernel behavior on H100.

jenna: interesting. why does flash not regress as much? is flash using a different KV layout or async DMA path?

dmitri: flash uses tiled async DMA with a smaller working set per block; fused tries to keep a monolithic KV buffer which appears more sensitive to delayed prefetch. paged explicitly pages KV to GPU on demand so it avoids big spikes at 2048.

ashley: action items:
- matt: can you revert/adjust prefetch default to 2x for now on H100 fleets (or add gpu-specific override)?
- dmitri: open a perf regression ticket with flamegraph + counters + minimal repro. flag as sev3 until we confirm fleet impact.
- jenna: add a microbench that runs fused@512 across batch sweep and fails CI if >10% regression vs baseline.

matt: will do. adding runtime flag gpu.prefetch_multiplier with per-device tuning. rolling to staging.

dmitri: filing ticket: PERF-1179 — H100 fused 512@8 regression tied to prefetch heuristic. attaching perf csv + flamegraph + the small run table. linking rerun with prefetch=2x shows mitigation.

jenna: one more note — L40S shows paged > flash at 2048 even with small batches. might be worth recommending paged as default for L40S for long-context customers. I'll add to Optimize recommendations. :memo:

ashley: thanks all. great triage. if anyone sees customer impact metrics rise on H100 pools this week, please ping #incidents. otherwise we'll track under PERF-1179 and roll a tuned prefetch override in the next deploy. :thumbsup:
